decisions.statement: A run of this file counts today's writing onto today's day.
Today is the day Alan's sleep opened rather than the ESO day this moment is in.
A day's window opens when Alan's sleep opened that day and closes when the next day opened.
A day whose window refuses raises rather than counting over a span made up here.
Nothing here counts a day over the six-in-the-morning ESO boundary.
Every word a commit added is counted.
A word a commit took away is subtracted from no count.
A file that moved is read as the move rather than as the whole file written.
A changed file counts as the topic that file sits under.
A topic is counted once on a day.
A topic a commit only moved is counted as no topic updated.
Both counts patch the one day page.
The wisdom words land before the intelligence topics.
A count that does not land leaves the other count to land.
A count that does not land is named on the error stream with its reason.
A run that landed neither count exits 1.
A count matching the count the day has lands no commit.
Nothing here decides when a count is due.

definition: the wisdom words Alan wrote and the learn-everything topics he updated on one day
